products.name: Cisco Secure Client (AnyConnect) VPN Deployment via Microsoft Intune — Commercial
products.short_description: Package and deploy the Cisco Secure Client (AnyConnect) and its VPN profiles across Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android through Microsoft Intune — consistent, hands-off remote access, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
products.description:
Deploy the Cisco VPN client to every managed device from the cloud

Getting the Cisco Secure Client (AnyConnect) onto a fleet reliably — the right app, the right VPN profile, on Windows, macOS, iOS, and Android — is where remote-access projects stall. This solution packages and deploys the Secure Client and its VPN configuration profiles through Microsoft Intune, so every enrolled device gets a consistent, tested VPN connection with no hands-on touch, deployed pilot-first and rollback-ready.

Run it yourself — simpler, cheaper, and proven

You do not need a consultant. The package hands you the field-tested method as self-guided, click-by-click documentation a competent admin can follow end to end — backed by ready-to-run PowerShell.

  • Simpler — exact, ordered steps with full navigation paths; every object you create is named and reused through testing and troubleshooting.
  • Cheaper — one fixed price instead of an open meter; a comparable consulting engagement runs well into the thousands per day. Reusable on every rollout.
  • Tested — a pilot-first method (Assess → Configure → Pilot → Validate → Expand) with explicit pass/fail gates.

What's inside

  • Solution Overview — how Secure Client is delivered per platform (Win32/line-of-business app, macOS PKG, iOS/Android store app + VPN profile), the app-plus-profile model, and where Intune ends and the Cisco head-end begins.
  • Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune licensing + enrollment, Entra ID groups, a Cisco VPN head-end/ISE, the Secure Client installers/XML profile, platform enrollment) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.
  • Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps to package the client for each platform, build the VPN device-configuration profiles in Intune, assign to a named pilot group, then validate, pilot, and expand fleet-wide.
  • 5 PowerShell scripts — deployment-readiness discovery, per-device install/profile validation, a VPN client + profile coverage report, safe remediation of failed installs, and a target-group builder.
  • Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.

The repeatable way

Every solution follows the same repeatable shape, so each deployment feels familiar and low-risk — buy once, reuse the playbook for the next wave and the next project.

The bottom line

The Cisco VPN client and its profile on every managed device — delivered from Intune, consistent across platforms, and proven on a pilot before you scale.

What you receive — every file in your download

This package is delivered as downloadable files you keep and reuse across unlimited devices — nothing is left out and nothing else is required:

  • Implementation Guide (PDF) — the complete, click-by-click solution: solution overview, requirements, step-by-step implementation, testing & validation, troubleshooting, best practices.
  • PowerShell Scripts (ZIP) — 5 ready-to-run scripts (read-only discovery/validation/reporting; remediation defaults to a safe preview):
    • CSCVPN-Discovery.ps1 — Cisco Secure Client VPN deployment-readiness discovery across Entra + Intune
    • CSCVPN-Remediation.ps1 — safely fix failed Secure Client installs / missing profile assignments
    • CSCVPN-Report.ps1 — Cisco Secure Client + VPN profile coverage report across the fleet
    • CSCVPN-Set-ScopeTargeting.ps1 — create/populate the pilot (and production) Entra group(s)
    • CSCVPN-Validation.ps1 — confirm the Cisco Secure Client + VPN profile are applied on THIS device

Delivered as a Word document and PDF, plus all PowerShell scripts in a single ZIP — yours to keep and reuse.
